privacy: Privacy Policy
Last updated: October 25, 2026   •   Operator: Jíjé Group Inc.
1. Who we are and who this Policy covers

This Privacy Policy explains how Jíjé Group Inc. ("Jíjé," "we," "us," or "our") collects, uses, discloses, retains, and protects personal information in connection with jije.ca, our applications, the Jíjé marketplace, customer support, and the vendor, driver, and other partnership interest forms (together, the "Services").

This Policy applies to website visitors, prospective customers, customers, and individuals contacting us or applying to become Vendors or delivery providers, including business representatives. Approved vendors, delivery providers, and employees may receive additional notices relevant to their working arrangements and any later identity, eligibility, or payment verification.

Personal information generally means information about an identifiable person. Business information can also be personal information when it identifies an individual, such as a sole proprietor or a named business contact.
2. Our privacy contact

Jíjé is responsible for personal information under its control, including information processed by service providers on its behalf. A designated Jíjé Privacy Contact handles questions, complaints, and requests about personal information. Email: admin@jije.ca. Please use the subject line "Privacy Request" where practicable.

We take steps appropriate to the circumstances to oversee our service providers, protect information, and investigate privacy concerns. You may also contact the relevant privacy regulator where applicable.
3. Personal information we collect
Information depends on the service or feature you use. We aim to collect only information reasonably needed for an identified purpose.

Website visitors and general inquiries: contact information you submit, messages, preferences, IP address, browser or device details, pages viewed, referral information, cookies, and similar technical data where used.

Customer accounts and orders: names, email and phone details, account preferences and authentication records, delivery addresses or pickup details, cart and order contents, participating Vendors, order history, substitutions, delivery instructions, support requests, reviews, and ratings.

Payment and transaction information: payment status, transaction references, charges, tips where applicable, refunds, and limited payment-method details provided by the payment processor. Full payment card information is generally handled by the payment provider rather than stored directly by Jíjé.

Prospective Vendors and business representatives: business name and type, contact name, email, phone, location or address, website or social profile, products or services, existing delivery or pickup arrangements, application notes, review status, and our related communications.

Prospective delivery providers: contact name, email, phone, city or service area, proposed vehicle type, availability, relevant delivery or shopping interest or experience, age-eligibility confirmation, application status, and related communications. The initial interest form is not intended to collect government identity numbers, banking credentials, insurance documents, or full identity records.

Location details: addresses you enter and, if a location-based feature is offered and you grant the required permission, device location data. You can generally provide an address manually for customer orders where the service supports it.
Other communications: survey replies, feedback, inquiries, messages, and information you voluntarily provide. Please do not send unnecessary sensitive information through general forms or email.
4. How we receive information

We collect information directly from you when you visit a site, register, submit an application, contact us, or place an order; automatically from your device when technologies are used; and from service providers or relevant marketplace partners as reasonably needed for the Services.

If another person submits information about you, such as an authorized business representative, we may use it for the purposes described here and take reasonable steps to confirm that it is appropriate to do so.
5. Why we use personal information
We use information for purposes identified at or before collection, including:
• Operating the website, accounts, and marketplace features; authenticating users; supporting orders, payments, refunds, pickup, and delivery where available.

• Reviewing vendor and driver expressions of interest, assessing suitability for the relevant program or service area, managing application status, responding to questions, and arranging next steps or later onboarding when applicable.
• Communicating about applications, accounts, orders, security matters, service changes, and support requests.
• Preventing fraud, abuse, and security incidents; enforcing applicable terms; and meeting legal, tax, accounting, regulatory, or recordkeeping obligations.
• Understanding use of our website and services, fixing errors, improving accessibility and performance, and developing marketplace features or food-discovery tools.
• Sending newsletters, launch news, or promotional messages only when we have an appropriate legal basis and any consent required for that communication.

We do not treat submitting a vendor or driver application as permission to send unrelated marketing. We do not collect application responses for the purpose of training unrelated general-purpose artificial-intelligence models. We may use properly aggregated or de-identified transaction, catalogue, or service-performance information to improve Jíjé services, subject to applicable privacy requirements.
6. Application decisions and future onboarding

An interest application is reviewed for potential follow-up and is not automatic approval or guaranteed work. We may request additional eligibility or verification information during a later onboarding process, using a separate secure workflow and any additional notices required at that time.

We may keep applicants informed about their own application and relevant onboarding opportunities. If we wish to use an application for a materially different purpose, we will provide notice and obtain consent where required.
7. When we share information
We share personal information only where reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this Policy, including with:

• Vendors involved in a customer order, to provide the items, instructions, and contact details necessary to fulfil their portion of that order. Vendors must not use order-related contact information for unrelated marketing without appropriate authorization.
• Delivery providers and logistics partners, to provide recipient details, delivery instructions, and order references needed for authorized deliveries.

• Providers working for us, such as website hosting, application or form processing, databases, payment services, email and communications, analytics, mapping, technical support, and security providers, under arrangements appropriate to the information and services involved.
• Our authorized personnel and professional advisers who require information for legitimate business, legal, security, or compliance purposes.
• Regulators, courts, law-enforcement authorities, or other parties where required or authorized by law, or where necessary to protect legal rights and safety.
• Parties to a proposed or completed financing, merger, acquisition, restructuring, or sale, where permitted by law and subject to appropriate protections.

We do not sell customer contact lists to Vendors. We do not share vendor or driver application details with unrelated advertisers for their own marketing without appropriate notice and authorization. An application alone does not authorize external publication of applicant information.
8. Cookies, analytics, and advertising technology

We may use essential cookies and comparable tools for site functionality, security, authentication, and saved preferences. We may also use analytics technologies to understand website performance and interactions. If non-essential analytics or advertising technologies require additional notice or consent under applicable law, we will provide the necessary choices.

Your browser may offer controls for cookies. Disabling certain cookies can affect website features. We will not place personally identifiable application answers into general website analytics events.
9. Email, SMS, and marketing choices

We may send application confirmations, responses to inquiries, account alerts, order communications, and similar service-related messages where appropriate. Marketing communications are separate and are sent only when permitted by law. Where required, commercial electronic messages will identify Jíjé, provide contact details, and include a working unsubscribe mechanism.

If you provide an optional marketing opt-in on a form, we record that choice. You can withdraw permission for promotional messages using the instructions in the message or by contacting admin@jije.ca. Unsubscribing from promotions does not necessarily prevent necessary responses to an outstanding application or service transaction.
10. Information accuracy, retention, and disposal
We take reasonable steps to keep information accurate for the purposes for which it is used. You may contact us to request correction of inaccurate personal information.

We retain personal information only while reasonably needed for the identified purpose, a lawful related purpose, or an applicable legal, accounting, security, or dispute-resolution obligation. Customer transaction records, active account details, and application records may have different retention needs.

Applications that do not progress to onboarding are periodically reviewed and deleted or de-identified when no longer needed for the application or a legitimately communicated future opportunity, subject to applicable requirements. We maintain internal retention and disposal procedures rather than retaining applicant information indefinitely by default.
When retention is no longer justified, we securely delete, anonymize, or otherwise dispose of information according to applicable requirements.
11. Information security

We use administrative, organizational, and technical safeguards proportionate to the sensitivity of information, including access controls, reasonable security procedures, and oversight of service providers. Access is limited to personnel and providers with a legitimate need.
No online system is completely risk-free. If an incident affects personal information, we will investigate and make any notifications or reports required by law.
12. Storage and processing outside Canada

We may use technology and service providers that store or process personal information in Canada or other countries. When information is processed elsewhere, it may be subject to the laws of that jurisdiction, including lawful access by authorities. We use appropriate contractual or other protections when engaging providers on our behalf.
13. Your privacy choices and rights

Subject to applicable law, you may request access to the personal information we hold about you, ask for corrections, withdraw a consent where applicable, request deletion of information that is no longer required, or challenge our privacy practices. We may need to confirm your identity before responding, and legal exceptions may apply.

Withdrawing information essential to an active order or application may prevent us from completing the requested service or review. Send requests to admin@jije.ca with the subject "Privacy Request". We will respond within the time required by applicable law.
14. Age and children

The customer-facing Platform is intended for persons aged 16 or older, subject to any higher legal-capacity or consent requirement. Initial delivery applicant forms are intended for persons aged 18 or older. We do not knowingly seek personal information from persons who are ineligible for the relevant service. If we learn that information was collected improperly, we will take appropriate action.
15. Third-party websites

The Services may contain links to independent websites, social networks, Vendor pages, or other services. Where you choose to interact directly with an unrelated third party, its own terms and privacy policy may apply. We encourage you to review them.
16. Changes to this Policy

We may update this Policy as our Services, providers, practices, or legal requirements change. A revised version will display a new updated date. We will give additional notice or obtain additional consent where applicable law requires.
17. Contact us
Jíjé Group Inc. | Privacy Contact | Email: admin@jije.ca | Website: https://jije.ca. For privacy inquiries, access requests, or complaints, please include "Privacy Request" in the subject line.

Jíjé provides marketplace technology and may facilitate payments, support, pickup, and delivery through delivery providers or logistics partners. Except where expressly stated, Jíjé does not manufacture, prepare, own, or take title to Vendor products.
Where the functionality exists, an order may include items from more than one Vendor. Each Vendor remains responsible for its portion, although checkout, support, or delivery may be coordinated.

Customer services are intended for people aged 16 or older who have legal capacity to use them or any additional permission required by applicable law. Driver interest applications are intended for adults aged 18 or older. A person submitting information on behalf of a business must be authorized to do so.

You agree to provide accurate information, keep login credentials confidential, and notify Jíjé promptly if you suspect unauthorized access. You are responsible for activity on your account except to the extent caused by Jíjé's own failure to meet its legal obligations. Reasonable checks may be required to prevent fraud or misuse.

The "List Your Business," "Start Delivering," and other partnership forms let people register interest in working with Jíjé. Submission is only an inquiry or application: it is not approval, a binding vendor listing, an offer of employment, a guarantee of delivery assignments or earnings, or a commitment by Jíjé to enter into a commercial relationship.

We may contact applicants to clarify information, review eligibility, discuss service-area availability, or invite them to a later onboarding stage. Applicants should provide accurate and current information and should not submit government identification numbers, banking credentials, or identity documents through general interest forms unless separately directed through an appropriate secure process.

Before a Vendor begins selling or a delivery provider begins accepting assignments, additional checks, disclosures, and a separate agreement may be required. Applicable statutory worker protections are not limited by these Terms.
5. Product listings and food information

Vendors supply or approve product details, ingredients, allergen information, photographs, quantities, availability, and prices. Listings can change, and images may be illustrative where this is accurately disclosed. Jíjé may format Vendor-supplied information for Platform display.

If you have allergies, dietary restrictions, or food-safety concerns, review the listing and contact the Vendor or Jíjé before ordering. An unlisted allergen should not be taken as proof that a product is allergen-free. Nothing here limits food-safety duties or consumer rights imposed by law.
6. Prices, fees, taxes, and payments

Where transactions are available, the checkout will show the applicable product prices and additional charges before an order is submitted, including any delivery fee, service fee, tip, and taxes where applicable. Vendors generally determine their product prices; promotions or discounts may have separately disclosed conditions.

By confirming an order, you authorize the displayed charge using the payment method you select, subject to any payment authorization or anti-fraud check. Payment processing and the parties responsible for collecting or remitting applicable taxes will follow the arrangement disclosed at checkout and any legally required information. Jíjé may use third-party payment processors and does not ask customers to provide complete payment card details through general recruitment forms.
Nothing in these Terms limits legitimate chargeback rights or statutory consumer protections.
7. Orders, acceptance, and unavailable items

Placing an order is a request to purchase the selected items. The Platform will indicate whether and when the order has been confirmed or accepted; the exact workflow may vary by Vendor, order type, or feature. An order is subject to payment authorization, fraud controls, operating hours, product availability, and applicable restrictions.

Please review quantities, items, delivery or pickup details, substitution preferences, and contact information before submitting. If an item is unavailable, we or the Vendor may contact you about alternatives. We will not substitute an item without an authorization permitted by your selected preferences or applicable law.
An order or part of an order may be cancelled or adjusted for a genuine operational, payment, safety, fraud, or legal reason, subject to any notices, refunds, and consumer rights required by law.
8. Scheduled and multi-vendor orders

If the Platform makes scheduled ordering available, an order may be recorded in advance for a stated preparation, pickup, or delivery window. Displayed windows are estimates unless expressly identified as guaranteed and remain subject to operating hours, capacity, stock, and payment verification.

If multi-vendor ordering is available, the order may involve different preparation times or pickup locations. A problem with one Vendor's portion does not necessarily require cancellation of all portions. Where practicable, we will explain material changes, charges, and refunds relating to the affected items.
9. Delivery and customer pickup

Delivery or pickup may be offered only in selected locations, for eligible products, and subject to distance, operating hours, courier availability, weather, traffic, access restrictions, and other operational considerations. Availability, fees, and choices presented during checkout govern the options for a particular order.

Preparation and arrival times are estimates unless a specific guarantee is expressly stated. Customers must provide a complete, accessible delivery address, accurate contact details, and reasonable delivery instructions, and must be available where the delivery process requires their participation.

If a delivery attempt fails because contact or access is unavailable or information is inaccurate, the process and any charges or refunds will be explained through the applicable order support and disclosed policies, subject to law. Perishable goods may not be eligible for return or redelivery. Pickup instructions will be displayed where customer pickup is available.
10. Cancellations, refunds, and problems with orders

For a change or cancellation request, contact Jíjé through the support method made available for the order as soon as possible. Available cancellation options may depend on preparation status, product type, and mandatory legal rights. Material cutoffs or non-refundable charges will be disclosed before purchase wherever required.

If something is missing, incorrect, damaged, unsafe, significantly different from its description, or not delivered, promptly contact support and include the order details. We may request reasonably necessary information to investigate and coordinate an appropriate refund, replacement, correction, or other remedy.

For an order involving multiple Vendors, a refund may relate to the affected Vendor's portion rather than the entire order, depending on the circumstances and applicable law. Voluntary credits are separate from remedies required by law. Nothing in these Terms excludes or restricts a statutory remedy or right that cannot lawfully be waived.
